description: Java class 'AsmAnalyzer' that analyzes JAR files to extract class information and filter classes based on criteria, using ASM library and ZIP utilities.

classes.name: AsmAnalyzer
classes.description: A utility class for analyzing JAR files to extract class data and filter classes based on custom criteria.

methods.name: parseInputJar
methods.description: Parses a JAR file to extract all class files as ClassReader objects, returning a map of class names to ClassReader instances.

methods.name: classReaderToAsmName
methods.description: Converts a ClassReader object to its fully qualified ASM class name.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters classes in the provided map based on a filter's acceptance criteria, modifying the map in-place.
